reason: My email runs on Outlook / Microsoft 365, and they say outright that Outlook isn't supported yet. The whole pitch is turning emails into tasks so I don't lose follow-ups, and that doesn't work for me at all.
objection: It doesn't work with my email, and even if it did, I've never seen a Reddit thread or a review saying it's stable. I'm not putting client communication in an app nobody has vouched for.
would_change_my_mind: Proper Outlook / Microsoft 365 support for email and calendar, plus a few months of independent reviews saying it doesn't drop or mangle email.
